projects.name: RAG assistant
projects.title: RAG & agentic knowledge assistant
projects.blurb: Chunking, exact vector search, grounded answers with citations, a ReAct agent with safe tools, retrieval evaluation and FastAPI, over your own in-vehicle engineering documents. Pick a goal; the page shows only what it needs.

steps.title: Chunk the documents
steps.builds: Paragraph- and sentence-aware chunks with overlap and source metadata.
done: you can predict where chunk_text cuts a document
tests/test_chunking.py passes

steps.title: Embed and search
steps.builds: Normalised vectors, cosine as a dot product, top-k with argpartition, save and load.
done: you can compute three cosines by hand and match the store
you can say when to switch to an ANN index

steps.title: Answer with citations
steps.builds: Numbered context, a grounding prompt, sources in citation order.
done: an unanswerable question gets 'not enough information'
you can say what the prompt cannot guarantee

steps.title: Add an agent
steps.builds: A ReAct loop, two tools, a safe calculator, and the same agent in LangChain.
done: you can trace one agent run step by step
tests/test_agent.py passes

steps.title: Measure retrieval
steps.builds: hit_rate@k and MRR@k on 12 labelled questions, TF-IDF against embeddings.
done: you can compute MRR for one question by hand
you can explain why 1.00 is not the end of the story

steps.title: Serve and test
steps.builds: Pluggable backends, an offline test suite, FastAPI /health and /query.
done: the suite passes with LLM_BACKEND=mock
curl /query returns an answer with sources

whole.title: The whole assistant
whole.summary: All six steps, from documents to an evaluated, tested API, and the story you tell about it.

projects.name: Federated testbed
projects.title: Federated learning testbed for vehicular edge clients
projects.blurb: FedAvg with Flower over gRPC, three heterogeneous vehicle clients (ROS2 container, lite container, bare-metal Raspberry Pi), features from live vehicle topics, and what makes the numbers credible. NITK minor project.

steps.title: Understand FedAvg
steps.builds: Rounds, local epochs, averaging weighted by examples.
done: you can compute one weighted average by hand
you can explain why it is weighted

steps.title: Server and clients in Flower
steps.builds: A logging FedAvg strategy, NumPyClients, metric aggregation.
done: two clients finish 5 rounds
fit returns a real train_loss

steps.title: gRPC transport
steps.builds: Clients dial fl-server:8080; failures are counted, not fatal.
done: you can explain why gRPC suits weights
a dropped client shows up as a failure

steps.title: A heterogeneous fleet
steps.builds: Compose for two containers, the Pi bare-metal on aarch64, MIN_CLIENTS=3.
done: three clients join one round
you can name what changes on aarch64

steps.title: Features from ROS2
steps.builds: A thread-safe sensor buffer and 12 features from speed and brake.
done: published topics replace the synthetic fallback
the fallback is logged

steps.title: Evaluate honestly
steps.builds: Held-out evaluation per client, non-IID splits, a centralised baseline.
done: no client returns a fixed accuracy
per-client and global accuracy are plotted per round

whole.title: The whole testbed
whole.summary: All six steps, from FedAvg to a mixed fleet with honest evaluation, and the story for the minor-project review.

projects.name: GPU ML pipeline
projects.title: GPU-accelerated ML pipeline (heart disease)
projects.blurb: A leak-free scikit-learn baseline, stratified metrics, the same data on RAPIDS cuML, logistic regression written as CUDA kernels, and speedups measured honestly with Amdahl's law. MA721 project.

steps.title: CPU baseline
steps.builds: Imputation, scaling and one-hot encoding inside a Pipeline; a stratified split.
done: the baseline runs
you can show the score with and without leakage

steps.title: Metrics that matter
steps.builds: 5-fold stratified CV, precision, recall, F1, a threshold chosen for recall.
done: mean and spread per metric are reported
the threshold is chosen without the test set

steps.title: RAPIDS cuML
steps.builds: Exported arrays, cuML logistic regression and random forest.
done: CPU and GPU accuracy agree closely
both read the same .npy files

steps.title: CUDA kernels
steps.builds: Forward, error, gradient and SGD kernels with a host training loop.
done: the kernels compile and train
weights match scikit-learn's closely

steps.title: Measure speedup
steps.builds: Warm-up, repeats, small against large models, Amdahl's law.
done: a table of median times per size
you can explain when the GPU loses

whole.title: The whole pipeline
whole.summary: All five steps, from a leak-free baseline to measured GPU speedups and their limits.
